hints.title: Consecutive Value Ascent Tracking
hints.text: A continuous increasing subsequence requires contiguous elements where each strictly exceeds the element directly preceding it.

hints.title: Running Streak Reset Invariant
hints.text: Incrementing the current streak length when nums[i] exceeds nums[i - 1], while resetting to one on equal or decreasing values, tracks contiguous runs.

hints.title: Linear Ascent Scan Procedure
hints.text: If array is empty, return zero. Initialize max length and current length to one. Traverse from index 1 to end. If current element is strictly greater than preceding element, increment current length and update max length. Otherwise reset current length to one. Return max length.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing increasing runs from every starting position takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single pass updates running streak counters in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should distinguish continuous subarray from general subsequence and implement the simple single-pass traversal.
